data.narrative:
Recursion Pharmaceuticals, a public-stage biotech company, was valued at $1.6B following $2B+ in total capital raised. The valuation assessment draws from a peer universe of 3 public and 8 private companies in Biotech & Health, including direct comparables Freenome ($1.1B), Alto Neuroscience ($1.0B), and Eikon Therapeutics ($539M).

Peer-median analysis applied to same-sector, same-stage comparables yielded an implied valuation of $1.0B, based on the median of the three public peers cited above. The peer range spans $539M to $1.1B. Public-comp anchoring via price-to-sales multiples was not applicable, as Recursion's revenue data is not on file; the Biotech & Health sector median P/S of 7.4x across 3 public tickers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) cannot be deployed without the target's revenue figure.

Triangulation based on the single applicable method supports a valuation range of $884M to $1.2B, with a median of $1.0B. Recursion's current $1.6B valuation sits above this range, suggesting a premium relative to same-stage peers. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue data, which precludes multiple-based cross-checks, and limited visibility into pipeline-stage or clinical metrics that typically drive biotech valuations.
